title: LearnOps H5P practice content types (B7, v1)
description: DRAFT, not approved and not frozen. The H5P content types a practice item may use (PRD B7): a list of entries, each one of five content types written as PRD B7 writes them, each at most once, and each pinned to its H5P library (machine_name) and exact version as verified on both lab Moodle sites on 2026-11-11 (the guide's lab check). The rules (ungraded, optional, relative paths, mentor approval, video checkpoint modes, interactive video for lab demonstrations only) are in contracts/h5p-practice.v1.md, which is the normative text. The shape of a practice item inside a course package is defined by B1 (contracts/course-package.v1.schema.json), not here.
$comment: Unknown fields are allowed on purpose: after Release 0 contracts change only by adding optional fields and readers ignore unknown fields (PRD B.0, EXT-02). The five names are the words PRD B7 uses; 'drag-the-words' and 'drag-and-drop' are two entries because they are two H5P libraries, and ordering is not a separate type in v1 (guide, 2026-11-11). Each name is pinned to one machine_name and one exact version by an if/then branch, so a wrong or swapped value names the field it breaks. These versions are the ones of 2026-11-11 recorded in docs/decisions/0005-h5p-content-types.md (PRD App-C item 5); h5p.org may publish newer ones, so a change is made only through a /contract-change. A later release may add a type as an optional entry. The list need not hold all five types. The lab-only status of interactive video is stated in the contract text, not as a field. NOT expressible in JSON Schema, so checked by libs/contracts/tests/test_h5p_practice_v1.py: that the names are the words in the PRD B7 text, and that this schema, the example, the contract text and the decision record all hold the same pins. NOT checked anywhere yet: that an .h5p file really uses one of these libraries at this version.

content_types.description: Each of the five content types may be listed at most once.

name.description: The content type, written as PRD B7 writes it (lower case). Not an H5P machine name.

machine_name.description: The H5P library's machine name. It must be the one pinned for this name (see allOf).

version.description: The exact H5P library version, as text (major.minor.patch). It must be the one pinned for this name (see allOf).
